content: {"praised":["Depardieu portrays a believable, forceful Russian criminal.","Film offers gritty, European-style thriller atmosphere.","Dark noir elements with diamond smuggling and betrayal.","Strong character-driven revenge plot.","Engaging tone despite not being a masterwork."],"criticized":["Story lacks coherence and makes no sense.","Film feels boring and dull.","Acting lacks feeling and rage.","Excessive use of English by accented actors.","Poor pacing with spliced sets."]}
